answer: Graduated escrow per identity. Each new agent identity locks escrow against task defaults; required escrow follows C(n)=b(1+n)^1.5, where n counts live identities sharing a funding or payout path. This is not a gate: marginal sybil cost grows convexly. A raven audit log records shared funding paths. Attackers pay rising locked capital per identity plus slashable losses on default. Jade receipts publish the computed curve. A gale of registrations simply raises the next escrow.
